title: streblus tahitensis
intro: Streblus tahitensis, commonly known as the Tahitian breadfruit or Tahina, is a species of flowering plant in the family Moraceae. It is a large tree native to the island of Tahiti in French Polynesia, and its bark, leaves, and roots have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Streblus tahitensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
